title: Hosting
description: Run Bureau as a service on your own machine, a VPS, or a hosting provider.

sections.title: Where to run it
paragraphs: Bureau is one Bun process with its state on disk, so it runs anywhere that keeps a disk between restarts.
table: Trying Bureau, or a personal office on your workstation.
Reaching your office from your own devices.
A public URL without managing DNS or TLS.
Automatic TLS and app subdomains on your domain.
A managed host with a persistent disk.
An existing cluster; run exactly one replica.

sections.title: Run it as a service
paragraphs: On Linux, install the example user service and point WorkingDirectory at your checkout. It rebuilds the UI, starts the server, and restarts it on failure. Enable lingering so the office keeps running after you log out.
sections.code:
mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user
cp docs/contributing/bureau.service.example ~/.config/systemd/user/bureau.service
$EDITOR ~/.config/systemd/user/bureau.service   # set WorkingDirectory
systemctl --user enable --now bureau
loginctl enable-linger "$USER"

sections.title: State and backups
paragraphs: All state lives in ~/.bureau, or BUREAU_HOME if set. Bureau writes a daily backup to ~/bureau-backups and keeps the last seven. Restarting the server interrupts every running agent turn; agents resume their last conversation on startup.
